summary: Silicon Valley resident, software engineer with over 25 years of experience, B.S. in Mathematics, independent consultant, strong advocate for open-source software, user of Mutt email client since the mid-90s, speaks Finnish and French, father of a bilingual child, critic of modern tech hiring practices, nostalgic for 90s tech culture, prefers small, efficient devices (e.g., Motorola Razr), strong opinions on property tax laws in California, experienced with self-hosting email infrastructure, critical of corporate tech culture and advertising-driven companies, enjoys biking as a hobby, has lived in the Bay Area for over 22 years, has a family member over 90 years old, values long-term software support and stability.
